commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) has tested the patience of referee Andrea Colombo and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+3' Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
90+3' Carlos Augusto (Inter) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
90+3' Shots on target – 7:1.
90+1' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' Carlos Augusto (Inter) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Now Inter have a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
86' Neat passing move from Atalanta in order to create new attacking opportunities.
80' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
76' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere will be replaced by El Bilal Toure (Atalanta).
76' The referee has issued a yellow card to Alessandro Bastoni (Inter).
73' The substitution is prepared. Davy Klaassen (Inter) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Davide Frattesi.

71' 4 - 0 Davide Frattesi (Inter) celebrates a stunning goal. He manages to win himself just enough space inside the box to meet the free kick and powers a perfectly placed header inside the right post.
71' The yellow card is received by Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta).
69' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Federico Dimarco is replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
68' Lautaro Martinez goes off the pitch and Alexis Sanchez (Inter) comes on.
65' A yellow card for a tackle by Isak Hien (Atalanta). Andrea Colombo doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
64' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
63' A lofted cross from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.
62' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Davide Frattesi (Inter) replacing Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
61' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
58' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Isak Hien (Atalanta) replaces Giorgio Scalvini.
58' The substitution has been made. Mitchel Bakker (Atalanta) has replaced Sead Kolasinac.
57' Today's match ends for Aleksey Miranchuk who will be replaced by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).
57' That will be all from Teun Koopmeiners who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Michel Adopo (Atalanta).
56' Ederson (Atalanta) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
54' 3 - 0 Goal! Federico Dimarco (Inter) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.

54' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the left post. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Marco Carnesecchi to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
54' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is going to take the penalty!
53' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) attempts to discuss the decision with Andrea Colombo, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
52' The Inter players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
50' Referee Andrea Colombo makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
49' A cross by Federico Dimarco (Inter) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
48' Surely that's handball by one of the Atalanta players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
48' The corner kick from Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

48' Federico Dimarco (Inter) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Marco Carnesecchi makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! Inter have a corner.
46' A pass by Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' Half-time substitution. Simone Inzaghi decided to make a change. Matteo Darmian is replaced by Denzel Dumfries (Inter).
46' Referee Andrea Colombo blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' 2 - 0 Lautaro Martinez (Inter) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top left corner in trademark fashion.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ederson (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Andrea Colombo didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
43' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' OFF THE BAR! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
39' Inter control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
37' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
34' Wasted effort! Nicolo Barella (Inter) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
34' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

33' Matteo Darmian (Inter) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Inter force a corner. They send men into the box.
32' Great teamplay by Atalanta as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
30' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

29' Matteo Darmian (Inter) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Marco Carnesecchi makes a great save. The linesman makes the right call and Inter will have a corner.

26' 1 - 0 Goal! Matteo Darmian (Inter) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the middle of the net. Marco Carnesecchi is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:0.
25' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
25' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
23' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Matteo Darmian (Inter) for his blatant foul.
19' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Nicolo Barella (Inter) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
18' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.

16' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
16' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
14' The goal by Atalanta is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
12' The goal for Atalanta is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
11' Goal! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
9' The Atalanta players are exchanging some short passes.
5' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
